description: Create role bindings in bulk. Requires a service JWT (com.atproto.server.getServiceAuth) and role.write. Every row is validated first; a single invalid or conflicting row rejects the whole batch. The batch and its audit event commit in one transaction.

approvalId.description: Approval identifier. Bulk role import requires an approved request from another administrator.

errors.name: InvalidRequest
errors.description: A row contains an invalid DID, role or duplicate subject.

errors.name: RoleExists
errors.description: A subject already holds a role binding.

errors.name: ApprovalRequired
errors.description: Bulk role import requires an approval from another administrator.
